newsitem.title: RUSSIA: New plane crashes before Moscow airshow, one dead.
newsitem.headline: New plane crashes before Moscow airshow, one dead.

text.p: A new Russian transport aircraft being prepared for its public debut at an airshow this week, crashed on Monday, killing the pilot, an Emergencies Ministry spokesman said.

"A BE-103 light transport plane belonging to the Taganrog design bureau crashed during a training flight near the town of Zhukovsky today killing its pilot," an Emergencies Ministry spokesman told Reuters. "The details and reasons are unknown."
The flight was part of preparations for the show in the Zhukovsky area near Moscow, which President Boris Yeltsin is due to open on Tuesday.
Russian designers have pinned great hopes on the BE-103 -- an amphibious design which can take off from either land or water and which they say has good export prospects.
The Taganrog design bureau is part of the Sukhoi military aviation group, maker of Russia's Sukhoi fighter jets.
